title: Triangular shelf bracket
prompt: Triangular shelf bracket I can print flat: 100 mm along the wall, 80 mm along the shelf, 10 mm thick. 12 mm wide arms all round, with a triangular window in the middle to save plastic (window edges 12 mm in from the outside edges). I'll drill the screw holes.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
100 x 80 mm triangle, 10 mm thick, ±0.2 mm
Eight flat faces: three outside, three window edges, two sides
